poc_requirements: Throughput: sustain 400 reqs/sec (avg payload ~120 tokens) with 99th pct fallbacks
Latency SLOs: p95 <= 200ms for short-chat (<=128 tokens); p99 <= 450ms under steady-state
Peak burst handling: handle 1k rps bursts for <= 30s with graceful degradation
Soak testing: 72h continuous mixed workload (chat + embedding batches + reranking) to measure memory leak/KV cache behavior
Reserved GPU planning: target sizing = 8 x high-memory GPUs (customer prefers A100-80GB equivalents) for predicted peak, evaluate 4/8/12 cluster configs
Acceptance criteria: no more than 1% error rate, <5% throughput degradation across 72h, latency SLOs met at 95% of intervals
representative_prompts: Short-chat: customer-support reply -> user msg ~40 tokens; expected model output ~60 tokens (low-latency path)
Claims-summary: long-document summarization -> 3-5k token input -> generate 300-500 token summary (throughput-sensitive, GPU memory heavy)
Reranking: 32 candidate retrieval reranking batch -> embedding + pairwise scoring under 300ms target per batch
Embeddings: bulk embed 5k-doc batch jobs nightly; target throughput 50k embeddings/hour
Safety-scan: classifier pass over LLM outputs (fast, CPU-involved pipeline)
